title: AvaliType Resourcepack
description: This Resourcepack is required for avaliType mod to Accualy type in avali scratch.
body:
This resroucepack is an adition to AvaliType Mod.
Without this resourepack the Circled letters the AvaliType mod puts in chat, will not be avali scratch
AvaliType Mod Required: https://modrinth.com/project/6urXIewG


The Font itself was made by SomeGuyNamedDavid:
https://fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/1108804/avali_scratch
